title: Hammerstein-Wiener Model
text: Simulate Hammerstein-Wiener model in Simulink software, 1 input, 1 output; {Model} sets the hammerstein-Wiener model to be simulated idnlhw and {Initial conditions} sets the initial condition specification for simulation. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Model
params.values: Hammerstein-Wiener model to be simulated idnlhw object

params.name: Initial conditions
params.values: Initial condition specification for simulation Zero (default) | State values
